change: S3a: S2 + AVX2 CPU tier computing RAM-resident experts in place from their RAM slots (native layout, 22 persistent threads on cpus 2-23, slots pinned per job, swiglu clamp = B004 fix), per-layer lanes by plan_layer min-max (VRAM->GPU, RAM->CPU or GPU-admit, NVMe->CPU after landing or GPU zero-copy without admission), layer-ahead NVMe prefetch (next layer's router on this layer's MoE input), -ambs 4

per_token.per_step_note: per token = per decode step / tokens per step (C2/C4 steps carry 2-4 tokens)

quality.slot_bytecheck: 128 VRAM + 128 RAM, bad 0+0, tables 0; 128 VRAM + 128 RAM, bad 0+0, tables 0
quality.decode_kl_method: same process, CPU lane off (exact GPU path) greedy reference vs forced decode of the same tokens with the CPU lane on (C052i method)

note: C2/C4 still ran one stream at a time: serve.py gives every job max_new_tokens = remaining context and exllamav3 reserves pages for it (no max_rq_tokens), so a second job never starts until the first ends (measured 1.0 tokens per decode step during C4); S3b sets a page-allocation round (max_rq_tokens 4096, not an output cap).
